sections.Profile:
Funhouse, produced by Williams in 1990, is a beloved classic designed by Pat Lawlor. The game centers around Rudy, an animatronic talking head who taunts players and interacts with the ball, creating a unique and immersive experience. The objective is to advance the in-game clock to midnight, putting Rudy to sleep and starting the multiball mode by shooting a ball into his mouth.
